legend: Have you ever played Hanabi? If not, then you've got to try it out! This problem deals with a simplified version of the game.

Overall, the game has 25 types of cards (5 distinct colors and 5 distinct values). Borya is holding n cards. The game is somewhat complicated by the fact that everybody sees Borya's cards except for Borya himself. Borya knows which cards he has but he knows nothing about the order they lie in. Note that Borya can have multiple identical cards (and for each of the 25 types of cards he knows exactly how many cards of this type he has).

The aim of the other players is to achieve the state when Borya knows the color and number value of each of his cards. For that, other players can give him hints. The hints can be of two types: color hints and value hints.
A color hint goes like that: a player names some color and points at all the cards of this color.
Similarly goes the value hint. A player names some value and points at all the cards that contain the value.
Determine what minimum number of hints the other players should make for Borya to be certain about each card's color and value.
input: The first line contains integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100) — the number of Borya's cards. The next line contains the descriptions of n cards. The description of each card consists of exactly two characters. The first character shows the color (overall this position can contain five distinct letters — R, G, B, Y, W). The second character shows the card's value (a digit from 1 to 5). Borya doesn't know exact order of the cards they lie in.
output: Print a single integer — the minimum number of hints that the other players should make.
note: In the first sample Borya already knows for each card that it is a green three.
In the second sample we can show all fours and all red cards.
In the third sample you need to make hints about any four colors.

legend.ai: 你玩过 Hanabi 吗？如果没有，那你一定要试试！本题讨论的是该游戏的简化版本。
整个游戏共有 25 种牌（5 种不同颜色和 5 种不同数值）。Borya 手里拿着 n 张牌。游戏因这样一个事实而变得有些复杂：除了 Borya 本人，每个人都能看到 Borya 的牌。Borya 知道自己有哪些牌，但他完全不知道这些牌的排列顺序。注意，Borya 可以拥有多张完全相同的牌（并且对于 25 种牌中的每一种，他都知道自己拥有该种牌的确切张数）。
其他玩家的目标是让 Borya 知道他的每张牌的颜色和数值。为此，其他玩家可以给他提示。提示分为两种：颜色提示和数值提示。
颜色提示是这样的：一名玩家说出一种颜色，然后指向所有该颜色的牌。
数值提示同理。玩家说出某个数值，并指出所有包含该数值的牌。
确定其他玩家至少需要给出多少条提示，才能让 Borya 确定每张牌的颜色和数值。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，Borya 已经知道每张牌都是绿色的 3。
在第二个样例中，我们可以指出所有数字为 4 的牌和所有红色的牌。
在第三个样例中，你需要对任意四种颜色给出提示。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 100）——Borya 的牌数。下一行包含 n 张牌的描述。每张牌的描述恰好由两个字符组成。第一个字符表示颜色（这一位置总共可能出现五种不同的字母——R、G、B、Y、W）。第二个字符表示牌的数值（一个 1 到 5 的数字）。Borya 不知道这些牌的确切顺序。

output.ai: 输出一个整数——其他玩家应该给出的提示的最少数量。
